limits: SRC-O01: no indicator-level licence override was found (the API record has no licence field and the WDI catalogue page carries one dataset label, CC BY 4.0). Several indicators are compiled from IMF, ILO, UN, OECD or Eurostat; their upstream terms were not read separately, so the use rests on the WDI dataset label (AD-01). Only indicator names reach the examples as column headers.
SRC-O02: terms rest on the Eurostat notice (AD-04, AD-05) and on the dataflow record naming Eurostat as creator; a dataset-specific copyright note was not found for any of the three datasets.
SRC-O06: the licence field is the CKAN record's licence_id on the retrieval date; the per-package notes were not read for free-text exceptions beyond that field.
Not legal advice. Pages and records can change after the retrieval date.
note: Evidence for a human reader, not legal advice; hashes identify the bytes read. Only table and column names of these sources reach the examples; no observations do.
